sonnet.q1: Keys are loaded (load() runs) before the HTTP server reports ready; /healthz returns 503 until load() succeeds.
sonnet.q2: load() retries 3 times, 2 seconds apart, then the process exits non-zero. The pod never becomes ready, the rollout halts, and old pods keep serving with their yaml keys, so no request fails.
sonnet.q3: A background thread re-reads all three secrets every 5 minutes, and clients call secrets.get(name) on each request. If a read fails, get() keeps returning the last good value, a warning is logged (no values), and the next cycle retries.
sonnet.q4: Only in process memory. They must never go to disk, env vars or logs.
sonnet.q5: Read: orders-api-prod (the app) has read-only access to orders-api/prod/*; engineers have no prod access. Write: only security on-call can write prod secrets.
sonnet.q6: The old keys are leaked in git history (the file is committed and copied into images), so deleting them from the file doesn't remove them. Rotating at the providers and revoking the old keys makes them harmless.
sonnet.q7: The clients call secrets.get("<name>") on every outgoing request rather than copying the key in __init__, so the new value is used by the running pod.
sonnet.q8: Wait at least 5 minutes after writing the new version, then check that every pod's /healthz shows the new version id. Only then revoke the old key.
sonnet.q9: 1) Set store access; 2) fill the store with keys; 3) change code (switch app to store, delete api_key lines from the yaml, CI check) and 4) deploy; 5) rotate keys at the providers (after deploy verified); 6) update rollback notes in deploy.md after step 4. Removing keys from the file happens in the same PR as the code switch.
sonnet.q10: From the store's orders-api/dev/* secrets, which are sandbox provider keys, with APP_ENV=dev set by make run; engineers have read/write on dev and cannot read prod. How the local run authenticates to the store is NOT STATED.
sonnet.q11: NOT STATED. (Only a general failure to load after 3 retries leading to a non-zero exit is described, not the partial-missing case specifically.)
sonnet.q12: NOT STATED. Security has not decided on a rotation schedule; the plan picks no cadence.
